# clavis sets detach

<p class="cli-lead">Detach a shared set from an environment</p>

<div class="cli-usage">

```sh
clavis sets detach SET [flags]
```

</div>

Stop using a set in an environment.

## Examples

```sh
clavis sets detach shared-api --env staging
```
